data.long_meaning: Jessa is a variation of Jessica, derived from the Hebrew name Jeshka, meaning ‘God is gracious’. In the Bible, the name Jessica appears in the Old Testament, where it refers to a Jewish woman who shows kindness to King Ahasuerus. In Christianity, the name Jessa represents the grace and kindness of God.
